Runtime translation accessors: resolve a dotted key against
Sourcesrc/core/locale/ui-text.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

_dig

Digs a dotted path ('a.b.c') into a possibly-partial object; null-safe. The cur == null → undefined guard on each reduce step is what makes missing intermediate nodes safe — dig({}, 'a.b.c') returns undefined instead of throwing on the second key read. Translation dictionaries are sparse during boot, so every lookup funnels through here.

(module scope)

Structural view of the live lang store slice — the three fetched nodes.

appText

Resolves a UI string from the live APP dictionary (store.lang.app, loaded from Firebase for the current locale) with the English snapshot as fallback.

  • @param path dotted path, e.g. 'media.preview' or 'pref.devTools.showGrid'

componentText

Same lookup for the components dictionary (store.lang.components).

routeSlugs

Route slugs for a locale: CMS-editable overrides (translations//slugs, loaded into store.lang.slugs) merged over the build-time LANG_SLUGS defaults.

  • @param lang locale code, e.g. 'br'

rightsText

Localized copyright line for the site footers — resolves source-code.rights through the live-then-fallback dictionaries and substitutes the {year} placeholder with the current calendar year so the stored translation never goes stale.

  • @returns e.g. 'Copyright © 2026 Luis Krötz'

rightsParts

Segmented copyright line for the site footers — the same resolved rightsText() split around the © glyph and the year so renderers can wrap those two tokens in emphasis markup without hardcoding where the translation places them. post carries any suffix after the year (empty today, kept for translation freedom); when either anchor is missing the whole line lands in pre and renders unsegmented.

  • @returns {pre, copy, mid, year, post} — render as
